name: tearsheet
need: Create or edit something in a tall flow of steps over the page, with its own head and foot

--ds-tearsheet-width.description: tearsheet: the box, never wider than the window less `--ds-space-8` on each side

--ds-tearsheet-gap.description: tearsheet: the room above the box (none at 600px and below)

--ds-tearsheet-padding.description: tearsheet: the padding of head, rail, body and foot at the comfortable density

--ds-tearsheet-rail-width.description: tearsheet: the step rail at the start of the main area

--ds-tearsheet-radius.description: tearsheet: the box's top corners at the default shape

labExempt.DS.tearsheet.create: events and steps: a step enters as DS.motion.enter's swap, shown in the entry tearsheet-open
